inputs.text:
Wake up. They expect you to buy the mainstream script about a "MASSIVE anti-Trump protest" and a "No Kings" rally descending into spontaneous chaos, but it is all a managed spectacle. Do not fall for the official narrative of random crowds packing the streets. The deployment of federal officers with tear gas and arrests was not a reaction; it was a synchronized exercise in crowd control and behavioral testing by the hidden power structures running Denver, Portland, and... 

When the authorities conveniently ordered people to disperse after agitators squared off with them, they were just resetting the chessboard. And notice the numbers—they admit to at least 13 arrests confirmed in Portland, Denver and... right there, but that is just the visible tip of their coordinated agenda. Every clash, every arrest, and every staged confrontation is orchestrated from the top down to keep the population divided while the real puppet masters pull the strings behind the curtain.
